## 395201c95f9d

**Reproduced semantic distribution shortcut — transformed matching is absent from the sampler.**

The canonical authority compares the third-panel query to the first two prototype shapes up to rotation and reflection. The generator chooses one stored shape and copies its cells into the query at exactly the same panel-local coordinates and orientation. A learner can therefore use the weaker rule “pick panel 0 only when the query’s occupied coordinates exactly equal panel 0; otherwise pick panel 1.”

I sampled 100 inputs in each difficulty band from generator SHA-256 `c321bdd392d6c65be668bc22bdd6d46054699f8771a137b893f60e31dac6c079`. All 300/300 queries were exact-coordinate matches to one prototype; 0/300 required a transform; all 300 passed the target’s validator. This is a finite sampler census, recorded in `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/counterexample.json`.

The exact counterexample is canonical train pair 0. Its query is a rotated/reflected version of panel 0’s L shape but exactly matches neither prototype’s occupied coordinates. The target validator returns no errors. Supported Racket application under executed rule hash `a99b04260a01` recolors the query with panel-0 label 4; the exact-coordinate rival falls through to panel 1 and recolors it with label 6. The complete input, Racket output, rival output, source hashes, command, and cwd are retained in:

- `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/input.json`
- `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/counterexample.json`

The separate official checks also reproduce missing `RULE_HASH`, weak self-check findings, and override-provenance failures under `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/`, but the transform gap is the primary semantic finding. No target files were changed.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed routine repair; complete lesson/axis/portable-test and interruption feedback retained. Portable-test and incremental-evidence subset now implemented; resume/semantic-policy changes remain separate work. Both audits and unscored solves retained.

## 395201c95f9d

**No issue found after checking; audit only, no source change.** Generator SHA-256 `fc4da9dc0021d34cede8847d5c99206574639aa63431d3b03b7a52466197d306`; declared rule hash `a99b04260a01`.

I exercised all declared exact-axis combinations in every band: 2,880 attempted and completed combinations over panel height, panel width, cell count, matched panel, and all eight D4 transforms, with zero exceptions, override mismatches, self-check failures, or unchanged outputs. I then tested all 16 cyclic four-demonstration starts for 20 seeds in each of three bands (960 lesson windows); `lesson_identifiable` returned no failures. Finally, 4,800 default draws passed `self_check`, and every declared rival executed without exception.

The exact counts, source hash, rule hash, and empty failure list are retained in `checks/audit/395201c95f9d/custom_probe.json`. This is bounded evidence over the declared grammar and rival set, not proof against every possible shortcut.
